name: FUSION_PRESERVING
hypothesis: Preserve existing F_TRUE prediction while testing incremental independently-refined RGB state
control: ZERO_RGB removes only first165 refined RGB coordinates; keeps RGB clocks, E state and full F_TRUE state/anchor. Both arms remain multimodal; this is not an RGB-ablation system.
normalization: Original phase-unit scaling, no additional fitted statistics
output: F_TRUE raw anchor plus unrestricted .03 residual; frozen F_TRUE native width logits plus correction; zero final layer reproduces native F_TRUE point and quantiles
optimizer: Native fusion_loss, global H mass, AdamW3e-4 native schedule, batch128, 2500 updates, seed7
gates: Original2% gates vsR_CTX and F_TRUE; paired REFINED_RGB minus ZERO_RGB4000 group bootstrap; 4% only secondary sensitivity
stages: New supervised H stage over already H-supervised frozen parents; not OOF
external_exposure: Previous research transfer already exposed; no external targets in fitting or hyperparameter selection; FUSION_STATE transfer still pending
